speaker: Narrator
lines: There was a time, not long ago, when other flags flew in… uh… wait.
Sorry, wrong script.
There was a time, 13.7 billion years ago, when time did not yet exist.
But yet, amidst the nothingness, there was something.
An incomprehensible being.
And under his command, the universe was.
He is the founder. The Founding Father.
And from him everything was born.
…what does this part say… ahem.
With his immense aura, he willed two realms into existence.
One would be for the living and the other for the dead.
And for the realm of the dead, the underworld, the Founding Father would assign one to be king.
The King of Ohio.
First it was a quark. Then 380,000 years later it would be a hydrogen atom. Then, an amoeba. Then it was a dinosaur. Sometimes it was a fly. A coronavirus.
A good 13.7 billion years passed.
Then it was his turn, to become "him".
And who is this "him", you may ask? Well, actually I don't quite know. Sorry, uhh… yeah. That's about it.
Why don't you keep playing the game and see?

speaker: Narrator
lines: After his first time in Ohio, a lawyer tried to escape.
Using a plane. Except he has never flown one before.
The results weren't too spectacular either. You're probably expecting an explosion, where he would jump out epic style, with a fireball behind him…
But no. He couldn't even get the plane to start.
So then, there he was, back in Ohio. And everyone knows that there is only one thing to do in Ohio.
Leave.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So, like, how do I leave this place?
I'm not quite dead, y'know.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Then you shouldn't be here.
This is Ohio, the underworld.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What do you mean? Ohio isn't the underworld. It's a city. In America.
Do you know what America is?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: America?
Hm. Seems like you don't get it.
You're from that Ohio upstairs.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: And what do you mean, "upstairs"? What's "upstairs"?
There's no stairs around here.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: I mean, the Ohio "above". On Earth.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Yes! I am a lawyer from the "above". From Earth. Get it?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Oh.
Lots of people above come down here anyway.
Nothing surprising.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Yes, but I am not dead!
How am I here? Why am I here? Why should I be here?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: That's what everyone says.
But, you want to go back up, yes?
And you said you're a lawyer?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: It's going to become "'was' a lawyer" if I don't get back up there!

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Hmm…
When there is a will, there will be a way.
If you have the will, I will show you the way.
And you will be out of here. I promise.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Blablabla…
So, are you helping me or not?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Do you have the drive, the power?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What the… Dude. Just show me the way.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Answer me.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Yes. Yes I do. Now show me the way.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You do?
Then you will work for it. Work your way out.
Work for me.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Work for you?
Like, what do you want me to do?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You said you are a lawyer.
Then be my lawyer.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What, you in trouble? What'd you do?
I'm Saul Goodman. You're lucky you found me. Best lawyer in town.
Whatever town this may be.
And you are…?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: I'm a man in a mask.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Oh, I can see that.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Of course you can.
I'm not questioning your powers of observation.
I'm merely remarking upon the paradox of asking a masked man who he is.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: In other words, if I was interested in revealing my identity, I would not be wearing a mask.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So you're not telling me?
Then how am I supposed to be your lawyer? I don't even know what you did. I don't even know who you are!

speaker: Masked Man
lines: All you have to do is follow me. I know what evidence to get.
Then you do the talking in front of the judge.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What?
So you're the lawyer now? Then why even hire me?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Do you want your way out or not?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So I've been following you around for so long… I'm tired, man. Care to tell me what you're looking for?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: 10 cubic metres of obsidian.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: For what?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: To send you back.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Huh? I thought you said something like…
"Uhh… you have to work for that!"
How am I going to work for it, if you're sending me back immediately?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: I have to find the obsidian anyway.
It can take you back. But I won't let you go back until you present it as evidence.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What… So your blocks of obsidian are your evidence?
Of what?
What crime did you commit, and why would obsidian clear your charges?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Can't tell you yet.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Ohhh… So mysterious, huh? Mask and all.
Then what am I supposed to tell the judge?
"Your Honour, whatever my client did, I'm sure he was doing it for TikTok!"
"See? That pile of obsidian there clears his name!"

speaker: Masked Man
lines: That is not my intention.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Then what is?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: The obsidian… will be a testament to my abilities.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The masked man points to a hill of gleaming black glass in the distance.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: And you shall be the first of many to witness it.

speaker: Narrator
lines: After stacking his cubes of obsidian into a frame, he takes out a lighter and starts a fire in the middle of the frame.
Nothing significant happens.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So what is this "ritual" supposed to be?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Hm.
This frame would have become a portal by now.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: A portal? Back to America? Earth?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You say it like this isn't also "America".

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Of course it isn't! Look around you!
This is hell! Not America.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Whatever.
You just don't see it.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: See what? Bald eagles?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: The more important issue now is that whatever I tried does not work.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So you're a fraud?
And I can't go back to America?
Hell! I'm not spending my life in hell!

speaker: Masked Man
lines: There is another way to send you back.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Yeah, right.
That's kinda like what you said earlier.
Why should I believe you?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Do you have anyone else to believe in?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: You don't get it, do you?
If there's no one to believe in, I'll just bust my way out of here!
Alone! On my own!

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You're free to try.
But do keep in mind that I do possess more knowledge about this place than you do.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Alright genius, what's the plan?
Some magic device?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Yes.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Pfft…

speaker: Masked Man
lines: And within this box should lie a rather valuable item.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The masked man pushes open the box to reveal…
Nothing. There is nothing inside.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So, guess air is quite a valuable resource in hell, huh?
That's it. I'm leaving.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You are mistaken.
The box did indeed contain a valuable item.
A portal gun.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Yeah, yeah, whatever you say, boss.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: The point is that it has been stolen.
It once belonged to me.
And your job as a lawyer…

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: …is to find evidence of the theft?
I don't even know what they stole!
"Portal gun"?
"Hey, my client says that a gun-shaped gun that shoots portal-shaped portals was stolen from him!"

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Only I am capable of using the gun.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Alright.
Then where do you suggest we look for your precious little gun?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Only one person could've stolen it.
Only one person could've tampered with my abilities.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Who?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: The one you're going up against in court.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: And who am I facing in court?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Come with me and I will show you who.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Not too long ago, a new King of Ohio ascended the throne.
But he was a tyrant.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: And what?
That guy stole the thing?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: I know what he wants.
He wants to amass power.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So you're taking me to meet him?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: No.
There are other ways to learn more about him.
Like through the manuscripts stored here.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What does that sign say?
"Royal Library"…
Alright.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: The library stores all knowledge about this realm.
Including the King of Ohio.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Oh, why do you keep calling this place "Ohio"?
This isn't Ohio. I've been there before. I come from there.

speaker: Masked Man
lines: This is Ohio. You are simply not looking correctly at it.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Alright, then how do I "look correctly"?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Through a portal.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Like the thing you can't conjure up?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Anyway, there is a problem.
Access to the library is barred for all individuals.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So…

speaker: Masked Man
lines: You will have to perform a heist.
The manuscript you are looking for is labelled "On the Founding Father".
The manuscripts should be sorted alphabetically.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: And how do you know what to look for?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Read the contents and tell me about it when you come out.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So it's human-readable? Not in ancient runes or something?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Hey!
I got what you want!
It just says! "He is HIM"!
Run! There are guards coming here!

speaker: Masked Man
lines: Stand still.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What?
There are guards hunting me down and you want me to stand still?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: I said, stand still!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Saul Goodman stands still.
The guards behind him no longer move.
He is confused, but before he can start asking questions, even stranger things happen.
A golden ring encircles him and he falls through the ground.
But he does not land. He simply continues falling, and falling…
All while a strange entity materializes in front of him.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: What?

speaker: Masked Man
lines: This is the Founding Father. Be respectful.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Although Saul Goodman has no idea what the entity in front of him is, something in him tells him that it would be unwise not to follow the masked man's instructions.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Alright.
Greetings, uhh…

speaker: Masked Man
lines: "Founding Father".

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Founding Father.

speaker: Strange Entity
lines: You have found me. Congratulations.
Not many can ever see me. But you have.
Thanks to your buddy.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Buddy? Nah, I'm just his lawyer.

speaker: Strange Entity
lines: And why would the King of Ohio need a lawyer?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Oh, because he got into some legal…
Wait. Who did you say he was?

speaker: Narrator
lines: For the first time, the masked man takes off his mask and properly introduces himself.

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: I am Don Pollo, King of Ohio.

speaker: Strange Entity
lines: I believe that the circumstances he was in made it difficult for him to explain the situation in detail.
Let me do that on your behalf, King.

speaker: Narrator
lines: All of a sudden, Saul Goodman seems to witness all of history in front of his eyes.
He learns everything, yet sees nothing.
Though he can recall everything, he cannot recall when he learnt of his knowledge.
And within his newly-gained knowledge…
…he saw for himself the fate that befell the King of Ohio.

speaker: Narrator
lines: It is the early 1800s. A man scribbles on some paper.
With the current formulations of the laws of physics…
…it is thus technically feasible to construct an autonomous device capable of entertainment and art.
Simple mechanical arms and an artificial voice box should suffice.
Here, I provide diagrams to illustrate the concept presented.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Below the lines of text, incomprehensible schematics can be seen.
Below the drawings lies even more text.
Perhaps, the miraculous machine would be more captivating if it had a more organic look.
Preferably, it should take on the likeness of…

speaker: Narrator
lines: The man pauses for a moment to ponder the appropriate words to use.
Not long after, he pens down his thoughts.
…a bear.
An animatronic bear.
The electromotive forces provided to the bear should enable swift and flexible movement.
With a complementary voice box, it would be capable of producing sounds.
Such an entertainment device could have many uses.
Perhaps one day, such a bear would come to replace opera singers today.
Automated opera. Automated entertainment.
And when that day arrives, I would no longer be merely a "scientist". I would become a "visionary".
And I very much look forward to that day's arrival.

speaker: Narrator
lines: With his writing complete, the man signs off with today's date and his name.

speaker: Faraday
lines: May 30th, 1833. Faraday.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Years pass. The scientist would indeed become a revolutionary.
The fast bear made it into opera theatres far and wide.
With its beautiful singing and elegant movements, the fast bear made news around the world.

speaker: Unknown Person
lines: Indeed, I must congratulate you, Faraday.
Your astonishing work in the field of physics, and now this magnificent piece of art…
You have brought wonder upon wonder to the world.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Yet Faraday was not satisfied.
Day after day, he wondered what would happen if he got too famous.
Would people attempt to take his life? He could not know for certain.
He needed someone capable to protect him.
Someone… something… what's the difference?
He turned to look at his robot bear.

speaker: Faraday
lines: …and here I describe new mechanisms, oriented for self-defence purposes.
They are to be integrated into the machine.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Faraday died in 1867, but not due to assassins or the like.
The bear continued to gain fame and attention and was called the Fast Bear by the media.
After Faraday's death, the Fast Bear continued performing, because it was autonomous.
Audiences were captivated by the Fast Bear's stunning performances.
But good times would not last forever.
20 years later, in 1887, a great incident would occur that would result in the Fast Bear being forcefully put out of service.
And the reputation of the Fast Bear would change overnight.

speaker: Stage Helper 1
lines: This bear arrived soaking wet in the rain… This should be fine, yes?

speaker: Stage Helper 2
lines: Most likely. The Bear has performed for so long now. If it wanted to malfunction, it would have done so a long time ago.

speaker: Stage Helper 1
lines: Alright. Then let's dry it up and send it onto stage.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: (singing)
(singing)

speaker: Narrator
lines: Out of nowhere, a blackout hits.
The audience panicked.
The Fast Bear also stopped singing.
The lights came back on not too long after, and soon enough it looked as if nothing had happened.
But the Fast Bear would not sing.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: Estimated number of threats: 200.
Determining elimination procedure…

speaker: Narrator
lines: A terrible disaster befell upon the audience that day.
June 5th, 1887. Newspapers report the "Bite of '87".

speaker: Narrator
lines: And it was on that day, drenched in blood…
That the Fast Bear learnt of bloodlust.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Not long before it was struck down and forcefully deactivated by the crew.
Since then, the Fast Bear faded into obscurity.
Years pass, and the Fast Bear would be sold as a collector's item from one person to another, to those interested in its past.
It drifted around, before ending up in a collector's home in Saudi Arabia.
In a thunderstorm, the Fast Bear would be struck by lightning…
…and move once more.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: (Where would this be?)

speaker: Narrator
lines: The Fast Bear looked around. There was nothing but vast desert for all he could see.
Not afraid of getting tired, he chose a random direction and started walking.
And he walked.
And walked.
And walked, till one day, he came across a camp in the middle of the desert.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: Who are these people?

speaker: Narrator
lines: Holding weapons, they stood in buildings marked by flags.
This was enemy territory.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: …threats. They are threats. All of them.
But that may not be the case. Hmm…

speaker: Narrator
lines: Out of nowhere, planes flew overhead.
Before the Fast Bear could even begin to fathom what they were, bombs had started dropping.
The stoic guards started running in panic.
The entire camp was levelled. Turned into dust.
That was the real threat.

speaker: Navy SEAL 1
lines: You! Put your hands behind your back! On your knees!

speaker: Navy SEAL 2
lines: Who's this? Some bear decided to show up here?
Looks robotic too…

speaker: Navy SEAL 1
lines: Don't get distracted!

speaker: Narrator
lines: The Fast Bear turns around.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: Who are you people?

speaker: Navy SEAL 2
lines: It can talk?

speaker: Navy SEAL 1
lines: Stop talking! Don't move or we shoot!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Confused, the Fast Bear moves forward.

speaker: Navy SEAL 1
lines: Open fire!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Big mistake.
Bullets rain down on the Fast Bear. They tear holes on the robot, but cannot stop it from moving.
The Fast Bear realizes. These are the same people who levelled the camp.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: Threat detected. Engaging…

speaker: Narrator
lines: Not long after, more men arrive at the ruined camp.
They don't seem to have come to help survivors. There were none anyway.
Instead, they were here to assess the losses.

speaker: Angry Man
lines: (Arabic) …what should we do now, great leader…
…bin Laden?

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Does it seem like there's anything left to do?

speaker: Angry Man
lines: (Arabic) Sorry…
(Arabic) But one thing survived the whole bombing. That robot over there. See?

speaker: Narrator
lines: The angry man points to the Fast Bear, now walking around the ruins in circles.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) He survived?
(Arabic) Doesn't seem human. More like a robot.
(Arabic) That sort of thing is possible?

speaker: Angry Man
lines: (Arabic) I suggest we take it in. A valuable asset to our troops.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) A war machine… to get rid of those Westerners…

speaker: Angry Man
lines: (Arabic) Be careful, great leader. It could hear us.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Which is exactly what I want. If that thing can hear…
(Arabic) …it can understand. We can talk him in.

speaker: Translator
lines: (Arabic) I can do the talking, great leader.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The squad walks towards the Fast Bear.

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: You were the people who owned this camp?
I am sorry for what happened. Warfare should not have progressed this much.

speaker: Translator
lines: Warfare… Yes!
(Arabic) He seems to support us.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Ask him if he wants to join.

speaker: Translator
lines: That was our camp, yes. Those Americans blew it up.
Do you hate them too? Want to join us?

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: (To think that the West has fallen this low…)
May I?

speaker: Translator
lines: Of course! What's your name?

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: You may call me the Fast Bear. Faraday's Fast Bear.

speaker: Translator
lines: (Arabic) That's his name, great leader.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Freddy Fazbear?
(Arabic) Tell him we welcome him. And tell him I'm the leader.

speaker: Translator
lines: Welcome, Freddy Fazbear!

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: (Freddy Fazbear? I like that name…)

speaker: Translator
lines: This is our great leader, Osama bin Laden!

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: Greetings, bin Laden.

speaker: Translator
lines: (Arabic) He says hello.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Freddy Fazbear completes basic military training in a mere 3 hours.  Others take months.
After just a couple of high-profile missions, America is forced to re-evaluate the strength of al-Qaeda.

speaker: American Military Officer
lines: Today I will present on the newest emerging threat: this robotic bear of unknown origin.
I believe everyone here is already familiar with its name. Freddy Fazbear.
This war machine boasts tremendous speeds, quick response times, and is made of strong reinforced steel.
Our intel on it is limited and only comes from eyewitness accounts, and there aren't that many surviving eyewitnesses.
I propose that we reclassify al-Qaeda to the highest possible threat rating, effective immediately.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Back at the camp in al-Qaeda, bin Laden holds a conversation with Freddy Fazbear through a translator.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) So, why have you decided to join us?

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: I found their use of weapons to be quite appalling.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Indeed. Those Westerners think they can be better than us. Yet our revolution will not die. It must not.

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: Revolution? Against what, may I ask?

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Against all of the world. One day, everyone in this world will thank al-Qaeda for their liberation.

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: World domination?

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) World domination! Haha, I like that!

speaker: Narrator
lines: And through more conversations like that, Freddy Fazbear realizes the true power that comes with world domination.
There was just one problem left.

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: Say, you've taught me a lot about the concept of world domination.
I just have one more question however. How can both of us dominate the world at the same time?

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Haha… when that day comes, you will rule the world alongside me.
(Arabic) I will control the world, and you will enact my will. How does that sound?

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: So I will not get to enact my will?

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Oh, please don't get the wrong idea. The world will be ours to rule.

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: I have no intention of ruling the world along with someone so selfish.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: Hm?

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: All this while, you have expressed your desire for world domination. I sense that my presence will not be appreciated.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Haha… Why so serious?
(Arabic) We can decide who does what when that day comes.

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: The truth is that you will cast me aside once I help you attain your goals, isn't it?

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: Well then. Today shall be the day we decide who gets to do what.
Who goes on to rule the world, and who will watch from the grave.
Only one of us will live to see the next day.
(Arabic) And it will be me.

speaker: Osama bin Laden
lines: (Arabic) Rally the troops! The bear has turned against us!

speaker: American Military Officer
lines: Sir, the situation cannot be allowed to worsen further.
This Freddy Fazbear has destroyed a lot of our offensive power.

speaker: American Military Chief
lines: Mmm… what do you propose?

speaker: American Military Officer
lines: Our efforts should be focused on a last ditch attempt.
The war cannot be allowed to continue any further. If we go all out now, we can avoid more future casualties and get the most chance at winning this battle.

speaker: American Military Chief
lines: Alright. I will approve this one last battle. No more after this.

speaker: American Military Officer
lines: Yes, Sir! Thank you, Sir!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Freddy Fazbear becomes the subject of urban legend.
A robot bear, who waged a battle against both al-Qaeda and the Navy SEALs…
The epitome of ruthlessness. It would be quite funny if he worked at a pizzeria to entertain kids, Scott Cawthon thought.
And Five Nights at Freddy's was born.
Over the next decade, the franchise would gain a sizable following. A movie dedicated to it was filmed in 2023.
What the director didn't know, however, was that the prop the crew bought wasn't a prop.
It was the real deal. The real Freddy Fazbear, weakened after the fight years ago.
Since that day, he spent 10 years in the joint, in an unknown corner of Area 51, destined to escape one day.

speaker: Director
lines: Good take, everyone!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Freddy Fazbear approaches the actor playing as the main character.

speaker: Josh Hutcherson
lines: Hi! Must be tough acting in that suit, yes?

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: (What suit…)
(If I could still talk, I would be correcting you right now…)

speaker: Josh Hutcherson
lines: Hey, you can do that? Make that angry face?
Chill…

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: (What is this man talking about…)

speaker: Josh Hutcherson
lines: You don't look very nice with that face.
Let me show you how to do it. Here.
That's right!

speaker: Narrator
lines: Through this brief interaction, the infinite rizz of Josh Hutcherson flowed through Freddy Fazbear.
He realized something. In order to dominate the world, you must work your way up. Enchant people to do your bidding as you move up the hierarchy.
Soon enough, you would be at the top, with everyone submitting to you without question.
Yes. Indeed. This is the power of rizz, Freddy Fazbear thought.
The century-long legend of Freddy Fazbear would finally come to an end when it was destroyed after filming due to mismanagement.
However, the nightmare had just begun.

speaker: Faraday
lines: That robot was getting quite old… Freedom at last.
I suppose this is… the underworld?
A world all the same. And a world needs a ruler.

speaker: ??? A
lines: This is the 228,091,874th time we are spinning the wheel.
This wheel will decide, out of 257,533,477,896 possible candidates, who would be the next King of Ohio.
The next King of Ohio shall be Don Pollo.

speaker: ??? B
lines: The records suggest that Don Pollo is a living person. This means that he is not eligible to rule the Underworld.

speaker: ??? A
lines: But the wheel is the only source of truth. Out of 228,091,873 attempts, not one attempt has produced an invalid candidate.

speaker: ??? B
lines: Seems like we will have to make an exception.

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: (Congratulations. If you can hear this, you have been nominated as the King of Ohio.)
(What's this voice in my head?)
(We welcome you to pay the Underworld a visit. The realm is yours.)
(How strange. How do I enter?)
(Simply will yourself to.)
(Alright. I will myself into entering the Underworld.)

speaker: Narrator
lines: Don Pollo finds himself in the Underworld, Ohio.
Temperatures soar, yet he does not feel hot.
Rather, the warmth simply warped around him, making him feel comfortable.

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: (Isn't the Underworld only meant for the dead?)
(There has been an unexpected situation.)
(We would not call it a "mistake", but you are the rightful King of Ohio, and we have no authority to refute this claim.)
(We suggest you look for a temporary successor in the meantime.)
(How would I start looking?)
(Simply will yourself into making an announcement.)
Hello, everyone. I am the new King of Ohio.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, I cannot assume the role currently.
I would like to appoint a worthy successor to aid me in managing this realm until my duties have been fulfilled.
(Can I will gladiator arenas into existence too…?)
I will be hosting gladiator fights. Since all of you are already dead, I do not assume anyone would hold back.
The winner will be crowned the temporary King of Ohio.

speaker: Narrator
lines: All of Ohio heard the King's words.
All sought to prove their worth.
Many would buckle under stronger opponents, who would themselves buckle under even stronger ones.
Eventually, one emerged victorious.
Strong, smart and feared by all who fought him.
People called him the Ohio Final Boss.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: …Made in Ohio!
…Wonder of Ohio!
…Star Platinum: za Ohio!

speaker: Narrator
lines: And thus he was crowned King.
Seeing how worthy and reliable of the role he was, Don Pollo returned back to Earth, assured.
It would be a while since he left when Faraday arrived.
All was peaceful in Ohio. Well, about as peaceful as Ohio could get.
But still, everyone praised the rule of the Final Boss.

speaker: Faraday
lines: I heard that the government was hiring civil servants?
Of course. I would be glad to work in the service of Ohio.
My name is Faraday.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Bit by bit, Faraday seizes every opportunity to be promoted.
Through his rizz, many people fell for his tactics, and he soon became the Final Boss' right-hand man.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Say, have you ever thought about… world domination?

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: World domination?
Why would I ever think of that? This realm isn't mine.

speaker: Faraday
lines: But look around you. Every square inch of land is yours.
The people bow down to you. The wind blows in your direction.
You are the King. Nobody is superior.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: I think there has been a misunderstanding.
I am only here temporarily. I will happily return my seat to the one who gave it up in the first place.

speaker: Faraday
lines: "Happily"? Don't deceive yourself.
Would you be willing to give up all that you have? Everything?

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: I don't see why not. I was content with my way of life. I am still content.

speaker: Faraday
lines: A wise man once taught me the power you get from world domination.
…Hm. Maybe "wise" isn't the correct word.
Once you obtain it, you cannot go back. It holds true for every person.
You claim you can let go. Claims are easy to make.
When that day comes, you will be crying and begging him to let you stay on the throne for longer. I know for sure.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: I will not. And I know for sure, too.

speaker: Faraday
lines: All I am saying is, everything here could be yours.
As long as you don't ever give up the throne, there is nothing he can do.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: I think I've made my stance clear.
I am only here to serve Ohio. I have no other malicious intent.

speaker: Faraday
lines: …Shame.
A person in power knows nothing about how to cherish it. How to enjoy it.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: I do not see how such a great responsibility can possibly be enjoyed.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Then let me show you.

speaker: Narrator
lines: All of a sudden, the Ohio Final Boss feels an unknown power reaching for him.
It strangles him. It suffocates him.
What could this be?
He stares into Faraday's enchanting eyes.
It is him. This man… Who is he?
The genius of a scientist…

speaker: Faraday
lines: And when that day arrives, I would no longer be merely a "scientist". I would become a "visionary".

speaker: Narrator
lines: The bloodlust of a bear…

speaker: Fast Bear
lines: Estimated number of threats: 200. Determining elimination procedure…

speaker: Narrator
lines: The ideals of a terrorist…

speaker: Freddy Fazbear
lines: Well then. Today shall be the day we decide who gets to do what.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The charisma of an idol…

speaker: Josh Hutcherson
lines: You don't look very nice with that face. Let me show you how to do it. Here.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: Who…
…are you?

speaker: Faraday
lines: Faraday.
Heard of me?

speaker: Narrator
lines: Both men pass out in the same room.
Only the Ohio Final Boss awakens.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: …Now…
…you will hear nothing but me.

speaker: Ohio FInal Boss
lines: I hereby declare…
Don Pollo is now a wanted criminal for abandoning this realm.
He shall be exiled. If he dares come back, I will make sure he is promptly executed.
This order is effective immediately.
Don Pollo is not welcome.

speaker: Person 1
lines: I told you… One day this guy would latch on to his seat and never give it up.

speaker: Person 2
lines: No way… He was such a great ruler. Ohio prospered under him.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Soon, the reign turned from a prosperous one into a tyrannic one.
Faraday got what he wanted. A ruler of the world.
But despite him telling himself that this was what he wanted… it was not.
He knew there was a mortal world beyond Ohio. And he had always wanted control over it.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: (This script suggests that there is a "third dimension"...)
(If I can figure out what it is, then I can send packets of culture to the mortal world.)
(These packets of culture are called… "memes".)
(I shall flood the mortal world with "memes". Make everyone know my power.)
(Soon, even the heavens above will know my name.)
(And when these people learn of my existence… I can then exert my influence over them.)
(All realms will be mine.)
(Mine.)

speaker: Narrator
lines: Yet despite his best attempts, he never got close enough to crack what the "third dimension" was.
If his memes could not spread at maximum capacity, how can he get what he always wanted?

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: (Don Pollo. There is an urgent situation in the Underworld.)
(We suggest you return to examine the situation. We also advise you to keep a low profile.)
(What would be a good low profile?)
(Mask yourself. Make sure nobody can recognize you, and do not be too conspicuous.)
(Ok. I will head there personally.)

speaker: Narrator
lines: And there, Don Pollo would meet Saul Goodman… and you've already heard the rest of the story.

speaker: Guard
lines: There they are!
Don Pollo and his accomplice! At the Royal Library!

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: Good…
Put them to trial. I shall guarantee their execution.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: So you're in deep trouble now, huh?
Y'know, for once I finally understand all your weird antics.
What would you have me do?

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: The Founding Father has already revealed the way.
Show them the third dimension.

speaker: Courtroom Official
lines: …Don Pollo and Saul Goodman?
Time for your trial. Get moving!

speaker: Narrator
lines: The final trial begins.
A serious looking judge appears.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The Ohio Final Boss starts yelling in court.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: You know what?
Screw it!
Screw all this court nonsense!
Yes! I am a tyrant.
And now, I will show you what all tyrants are good at.
Violence.

speaker: Narrator
lines: A fiery swing of a sword and the courtroom is immediately sliced in two.
Mere seconds later, the courtroom collapses into rubble. Flames engulf the ruins.
Saul Goodman escapes into the third dimension, while Don Pollo is left nowhere to be seen.
Unable to locate Saul Goodman, the Ohio Final Boss shouts into the air in all directions.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: Hm? What're you looking for?
Your buddy is gone?
I'm sorry for your loss.
Now, fight me. You and me. Without all that lawyer and court nonsense.
Only you and only me.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: Heh.
You managed to defeat me?
Or is that just what you tell yourself?
None of you… know who I am, or what I have achieved.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Don Pollo appears behind the Final Boss, standing, after coming out of seemingly nowhere.

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: I know. You were capable.

speaker: Ohio FInal Boss
lines: You're back?
Hah. Indeed, I am capable.
But thanks to you, I now know what it all means…
Maxwell's equations. The cross product.
The third dimension.
And I am willing to bet… that the body I am inheriting does not even know of it.
Come. Face me. In all three dimensions.

speaker: Don Pollo
lines: Faraday.

speaker: Faraday
lines: You already know who I am. Good.
Then there is no longer any point in maintaining this disguise.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: And there will be no more need to deny who I am.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Recognizing your enemy is the first step to defeating them.
But can you take your next step forward?
I don't think so.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Heh…
You're good…
To be honest, I will miss my days as a tyrant.
Heheh…

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: You "will"?
Guards. Find this man's actual body and chain him up.
I want to hear him talk for the last time.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Faraday awakens in his body, now tied to chains against a wall.

speaker: Faraday
lines: …So this is where I end up.
Well. Whatever.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: You really think you get the luxury of staying here?
Ohio won't accommodate people like you.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Oh?

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: There is a better place.
The Eternal Slumber, where you will never awaken again.

speaker: Faraday
lines: So such a place exists… Interesting.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: Interesting or not, you won't feel anything once you're there.
You won't even be able to think.
So I am here… to hear your last words, see your last breath, and feel your last thoughts.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Well, you've seen it all. I've said all I wanted to say. I assume you are satisfied.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: To think I lost to such a despicable man.
I'm sorry, King of Ohio. I have failed you.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: You did what you could. He was a formidable foe.

speaker: Faraday
lines: Haha… thank you.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: You do the honours.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The Final Boss stares at Faraday.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: …Wonder of Ohio!

speaker: Narrator
lines: The Final Boss and the King watch as Faraday disintegrates into nothing.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: And that would be the end of his legacy.
I saw it all. 200 years in the making…

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: His "legacy"?

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: He sure had an interesting story. Maybe one day I will tell you about it.
For now, I have other things to do in the Overworld.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: You're letting me take your place again?

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: I am sure I have not misjudged your character.

speaker: Ohio Final Boss
lines: Yes, King of Ohio! I humbly serve thee.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: Haha…

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: You said you wanted to go back to the Overworld, yes?

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: And here I thought you forgot…
Actually, I kinda forgot too. After all that stuff.

speaker: Narrator
lines: The King of Ohio stands before the obsidian frame he built not too long ago.
This time, the portal lights up.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: Here you go.
See, I wasn't lying. I can make portals.

speaker: Saul Goodman
lines: Of course, King of Ohio…
Goodbye.

speaker: King of Ohio
lines: Maybe we will meet again someday.

speaker: Narrator
lines: Saul Goodman steps through the portal, and it breaks behind him.
Don Pollo returns back to the mortal realm and checks his phone.
